content.text:
Thinking aloud as I read:

- Black background, lots of yellow and green. Title: "קרן השתלמות: הסיפור של הכסף, שלב אחרי שלב". Keren hishtalmut is a word I know, so I'll stay a little.
- "חשבון ניירות ערך". I don't really know what that is. Maybe the stock exchange?
- The small grey box with the tiny drawing: I can't read it even with the glasses on.
- "הדוגמה: שכר ברוטו 12,000 ₪ בחודש…": there's orange writing, "S&P500", "דמי ניהול 0.54%"… S, P, five hundred. Too many letters and numbers. I'm skipping this paragraph.
- "א. הערימה גדלה" with a green label "מומלץ". So they're the ones recommending it.
- Columns. Above them: 18,000 ₪, then "+54,000 ₪". So the employer adds 54,000? That's a lot. Then "−13,974 ₪" over a red striped box, "המס לקח". That frightens me. Then 66,513 ₪ "נשאר בידיים", and 83,978 ₪ "אם מחכים לשנה 6".
- The row of small columns at the top with numbers 1 to 12: I didn't understand it. A circle on 5.
- Screen two shows the same thing again for year 6, with "המס לקח 0 ₪". So if you wait 6 years there's no tax. That I understood.
- "ב. אותו סיפור בשורות". Here each row has the words on the right and the number right under them: "הפקדתם 18,000 ₪", "המעסיק הוסיף +54,000 ₪", "המס לקח −13,974 ₪", "נשאר בידיים 66,513 ₪". I read it from right to left like a list, and I don't have to look up and down between the number and its label. That's easier for me.
- The bit about 19 tracks and "דמי ניהול 0.7%": small and pale, skipping it.

**What I'd tell my son:**

"Listen, I'd pick the second drawing, the one with rows, B. It's like a list. On the right it says what happened and the amount is right next to it: I put in 18,000, the employer added 54,000, the tax took 13,974, and I'm left with 66,513. In the first one, with the tall columns, I kept going up and down between the number at the top and the words at the bottom, and I got lost. They put 'מומלץ' on the first one, but that doesn't change my mind.

What I understood: the employer adds a lot, and if you wait 6 years the tax is zero. That's the important thing. What 'חשבון ניירות ערך' is, I don't know. And the row of small columns numbered 1 to 12 with a circle on 5, I didn't understand at all.

The paragraph at the top with S&P500, 'מסלול מיטב' and percentages, I skipped. The small grey writing at the bottom about 19 tracks and management fees I couldn't read properly. In both drawings there's a red striped box with a minus sign, 'המס לקח'. It frightened me, even though it later turned out that after 6 years it goes away.

The dark background with yellow and green, and so many numbers, wore me out. By the end of the second screen I'd had enough."
